name: Obaidullaganj–Bilaspur Highway
aka: Obaidullaganj–Jabalpur section was part of the former NH 12

timeline.event: Route extended from Jabalpur to Bilaspur

history: NH 45 starts at Obaidullaganj, a town just south of Bhopal, and runs east across Madhya Pradesh to Jabalpur. From there it climbs through the forested Maikal hills past Dindori and drops into the plains of Chhattisgarh to end at Bilaspur. The road was extended from Jabalpur to Bilaspur in 2016, and its path was chosen to keep highway traffic away from the Achanakmar wildlife sanctuary and the Amarkantak hills.
facts: The Obaidullaganj–Jabalpur stretch was part of the old NH 12 from Bhopal.
Extended from Jabalpur to Bilaspur in June 2016.
Its alignment was shifted to avoid cutting through the Achanakmar wildlife sanctuary.
About 504 km lie in Madhya Pradesh and 148 km in Chhattisgarh.
